newsitem.title: USA: Global Gaming patent ruled invalid.
newsitem.headline: Global Gaming patent ruled invalid.

text.p: Global Gaming & Technology Inc said February 21, the Federal Court for the District of Nevada ruled International Gaming Technology's S-Slot machines infringe a patent which was held by Global Gaming & Technology Inc.

However, the company said the court further held Global Gaming's patent was invalid because the claimed invention had been on sale more than one year prior to the date on which Global Gaming's patent application was filed in 1975.
Therefore, the company said the court entered a judgment in favor of International Gaming Technology.

Global Gaming said it disagrees with the legal and factual analysis made by the court in the "on-sale" portion of its opinion and intends to appeal the decision to the Federal Circuit Court of Appeals.
